name: skills
one_liner: Anthropic's official free collection of example 'skills' (instruction packs) that teach Claude how to do specific jobs, like creating Word documents or editing spreadsheets.
buyer: A software consultant or agency that builds custom Claude-powered tools for clients and wants a reliable, official reference for how to structure a new skill correctly.
business_use_cases: An agency studies the official document-creation skills (docx, pdf, pptx) as a template, then builds a client-branded version that auto-generates reports in the client's own format.
A trainer runs corporate workshops teaching non-technical teams how to write their own custom skills for internal workflows, using this repo as the syllabus.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a niche, well-polished skill (e.g. for a specific industry like legal contract review) modeled on these examples, distributed via a marketplace.
Offer paid 'skill audits' where you review a company's internal skills against Anthropic's official patterns for reliability.

steal_this: Pick one under-served niche (e.g. real-estate listing descriptions) and ship a single polished skill this weekend, using the official template-skill folder as your starting point.
